title: Execute fresh V16 product-quality W4A8 policy preflight

candidate_plan.role: frozen successor acceptance, evaluator-repair, publication, and authority contract

implementation_objective: Under exactly one fresh V16 construction authority, first pass the non-consuming inherited-matrix and evaluator-production-path regressions, then reproduce the exact V15 quantized reference from its sealed V10 transformer and isolated V12 lm_head sources, persist all constructor and 312-event Dynamic Scale32 proofs, and execute exactly the unchanged V13-V15 product-quality matrix. Count actual model forwards for activation auditing, durably publish each completed campaign response before post-generation assertions, complete deterministic replay and all quality artifacts, and submit immutable evidence to a Fresh Reviewer. Do not modify RTL, retarget the live chat demo, access U280 tools, or use BF16 token identity as the acceptance oracle.

required_checks: restore the V16 plan after inherited V13 matrix freeze and verify the exact visible matrix hash
exercise variable-length single-turn and two-turn generation through the V16 generation function
prove actual model-forward count equals the sum of per-response generation steps and differs from response count
prove campaign raw outputs are byte-identical when the normal publication call observes the already failure-safe file
create token_and_latency_results.json, rubric_results.json, RESULT.json, and SHA256SUMS and pass the V16 terminal quality-bundle verifier
force a post-generation activation assertion and prove every completed campaign record was already durable

required_constructor.embedding: preserve the source BF16 embedding bytes and detach lm_head storage before any weight replacement
required_constructor.transformer: reconstruct exactly the sealed V10 representation for all 168 transformer Linear tensors, including four-bit payload, packed Scale24 rows, dual codebooks, per-row/block selectors, padding, and authentication
required_constructor.lm_head: reconstruct exactly the isolated V12 64 contiguous groups of 2374 rows with seven dual-bank input-block records per group and one selector bit per output row/block
required_constructor.determinism: two clean independent constructions must match all payload, metadata, state, reconstruction, tokenizer, prompt-matrix, and manifest hashes
construction_inputs_forbidden: V15 generated response text or token arrays

required_self_tests: reject any plan, task, source, model, tokenizer, template, V10, V12, V13, V15 terminal, helper, diagnostic, or review-record hash mismatch before construction
prove the source embedding bytes remain unchanged and lm_head storage is not aliased to the embedding
prove all 168 transformer tensors exactly match the sealed V10 decoded representations and metadata
prove the lm_head decoded representation and metadata exactly match the isolated V12 64-group construction
round-trip every packed Scale24 record with a restored zero high byte and reject malformed or lossy encodings
round-trip every codebook, selector stream, group transition, alignment byte, and authentication record
prove exact whole-model payload, metadata, and total byte counts
prove candidate A and candidate B construction manifests are identical
run all 312 named grouped Dynamic Scale32 events with no saturation, clipping, or reserved -128 payload and no more than 832 transport-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token
freeze the inherited matrix, restore the V16 plan, and execute the exact visible_matrix_sha256 lookup without creating an official namespace or quality marker
persist candidate manifests, exact-reproduction reports, codec/byte accounting, and dynamic_preflight before any quality marker
prove the inherited V13 quality matrix bytes and hashes are frozen before any V16 candidate output is generated
prove each response model_forward_count equals its generation-loop model calls and campaign activation auditing uses their exact sum
prove raw campaign records are append-and-fsync durable before post-generation activation assertions and are never silently rewritten
prove deterministic greedy re-execution reproduces every token ID and decoded output exactly without changing the frozen result
prove verify-result checks every quality checksum and the response-count versus model-forward-count dimensional closure

quality_execution.matrix_source: hash-bound V13 plan frozen_product_quality_matrix inherited unchanged through V15 and V16

required_quality_artifacts: predeclared_contract.json binding all source, model, tokenizer, plan, task, predecessor, matrix, helper, review, and environment hashes
constructor_self_test.json including inherited-matrix and evaluator-production-path regressions

failure_taxonomy.construction_or_codec_failure: preserve PRODUCT_PREFLIGHT_NO_GO with exact mismatch records; no quality execution
failure_taxonomy.dynamic_policy_failure: preserve PRODUCT_PREFLIGHT_NO_GO with named event evidence; no quality execution
failure_taxonomy.evaluator_no_execution: preserve EVALUATOR_NO_EXECUTION with null quality conclusion; do not classify RTL or numerical correctness
failure_taxonomy.evaluator_failure_after_campaign_consump: preserve every already durable raw response and terminal failure with null quality conclusion; no replay
failure_taxonomy.quality_failure: preserve PRODUCT_QUALITY_NO_GO with all raw outputs and failed rubric dimensions
failure_taxonomy.quality_pass: preserve PRODUCT_QUALITY_READY and submit immutable evidence to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or advance the stage locally

prohibited_actions: modify RTL, verification references, sealed V10/V12/V13/V14/V15 evidence, or consumed exactly-once evidence
resume, repair, replay, reconstruct outputs, or write new evidence under the V15 namespace
consume the V16 construction marker from a Planner cycle or create more than one V16 quality campaign
use exact BF16 token identity, BF16 response-gate identity, or the obsolete 4.036 cap as a V16 acceptance requirement
tune weights, metadata, prompts, generation settings, holdouts, or rubric after observing V16 outputs
hide prompts, use a hidden harness, inspect a golden output, or omit raw failed outputs
claim accelerator completion from the quantized software reference
download or install a proprietary FPGA toolchain
completion_rule: The Engineer mission is complete only after immutable V16 construction/dynamic no-go evidence, evaluator-no-execution evidence, or one frozen product-quality campaign plus Fresh Reviewer submission. A quality pass is a specification-stage policy result only; selected_policy_id remains null and RTL/demo/U280 work remains locked until Fresh Review and Manager stage advance.
